Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires and the players have made their way out in the middle. Hayley Matthews and Rashada Williams are the openers for the West Indies Women. Jane Maguire comes to bowl. Here we go...
... The Run Chase ...

What a comeback this has been by West Indies Women. Some exceptional death bowling on display. Ireland Women were 116/3 in 15.3 overs and in he next 27 balls West Indies Women were able to take 6 more wickets for just 21 runs. Shamilia Connell stood out with her three-fer. So, West Indies Women have their task cut out here. They onus now is on their batters to get them over the victory line here. Do join us for the chase shortly.

Ireland Women were off to a cautious start. Amy Hunter could not make much of a difference and slipped out very early. Orla Prendergast and Gaby Lewis' stand was the crucial one to get them back on track. Orla Prendergast was batting on some other deck as she raced to her half-century but she could not continue for long. Gaby Lewis took her time to find her groove and added valuable 38 runs to the total. Although, once Lewis fell at the start of death overs, it all went downhill for Ireland Women. They kept losing wickets at regular intervals and could not counterpunch in the death.
A poor batting display by Ireland Women in the death overs. They were on track to get near the 160-run mark but West Indies Women have done really well to pull things back in their favour.

OUT! RUN OUT! Rashada Williams wins the race. It is short and on off. Murray looks to heave it away but misses. Mary Waldron takes off nevertheless. Rashada Williams collects the ball, runs towards the stumps and underarms at the striker's end to score a direct hit. Mary Waldron is short. Ireland Women end innings at 137/9.

OUT! CAUGHT! Good length, outside off. Leah Paul lofts it down the ground. Chinelle Henry takes a sharp catch running backwards. Leah Paul never got the desired distance on her shot. Ireland Women are falling apart here. Murray comes in for the final delivery.
Commentary.Howout: c Chinelle Henry b Shamilia Connell

Commentary.Commentary: Length and on off. Paul helps it back to the bowler.

Goes full and on middle. Mary Waldron sweeps it to square leg and takes a single. West Indies Women take a review for lbw. Although it goes down in vain, as the UltraEdge confirms that the ball comes off her gloves.
WIDE! It is full, going down leg. Wide called.
Length ball, angled across, outside off. Leah Paul knocks it down to long off for a single.
It is full, on leg. Mary Waldron whips it to mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Hayley Matthews picks up a wicket on her very last delivery of her spell. It is a full toss, on off. Eimear Richardson makes some room and smacks it back to the bowler. Hayley Matthews takes a sharp catch of her own bowling here. The skipper leading from the front here. Leah Paul comes in to bat now.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, helped back to the bowler.
BYE! Quicker and full, around off. Eimear Richardson gets low for the sweep but misses it. They collect a bye.
Fuller, outside off. Eimear Richardson prods and reverse sweeps it to third man for a brace.
Slower, full and on leg. Mary Waldron nudges it to mid on. They take one.
It is full, going down leg. Eimear Richardson goes for the sweep but does not get any bat on ball.
Mary Waldron gets off the mark with a single as this is full ball is tapped to point.
Fuller, on leg. Mary Waldron tucks it out to the leg side.

OUT! CAUGHT! Afy Fletcher now strikes twice in her over, just like Karishma Ramharack. It is floated and full, on off. Arlene Kelly tries to heave it over covers but does not time it well. The ball comes off the outside edge and lobs towards extra cover. Hayley Matthews runs to her left and takes a good sliding catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Hayley Matthews b Afy Fletcher

Commentary.Commentary: On off, smacked back to the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT! Afy Fletcher gets her first wicket here. It is tossed up, outside off. Laura Delany uses her feet but ends up chipping it to mid off. Chinelle Henry there pouches it safely with both hands. Ireland Women now have half of their side back in the hut here. Arlene Kelly is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Chinelle Henry b Afy Fletcher

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Smacked. Henry goes full, wide outside off. Eimear Richardson latches onto it and drills it past mid off for four runs. Ireland Women need more boundaries to finish on a high here.
A single now as this is pushed to the off side.

It could've been a run-out but Chinelle Henry spills the ball on the ground. It is full and on off. Eimear Richardson taps it to mid off and crosses. The fielder does really good but the bowler makes a meal of it.
Eimear Richardson makes some room and tries to slap this short ball through the line but misses.

FOUR! Innovation at its best. It is fuller in length, outside off. Eimear Richardson gets across and goes for the scoop. It comes of the side of the blade, beats the keeper and runs down to the fence.
WIDE! This is full, outside the tramline. Wide called.
A slower full-length ball, outside off. Eimear Richardson shuffles and tries to scoop it away but misses.

OUT! BOWLED! Karishma Ramharack gets her second wicket in the over. She is able to end her spell with two wickets to her name. It is quicker, angled into the pads on a fuller length. Louise Little makes some room and tries to flick it away but misses as she ends up playing all around it. The ball hit her on the pads and deflects on to the stumps. Ireland Women now in a spot of bother. Laura Delany is the new batter in.
Flatter and outside off. Little tries to reach out but miscues it back to the bowler.
It is full, angled into the pads. Little tucks it to mid on.
Louise Little comes in at number 5.

OUT! LBW! Karishma Ramharack appeals and the finger goes up. This could be a huge wicket as it is Gaby Lewis on the line. She takes the review straightaway. Coming to the delivery - It is tossed up, on fourth stump, fuller. It grips and turns in. Lewis gets low and tries to sweep it away but misses. She takes a blow on her pads. The Ball Tracking shows three reds and Lewis walks back after a well-played 38.
Shorter, wide of off. Gaby Lewis has some width on offer but she makes a mess of it.
Goes full and outside off. Eimear Richardson reaches out and lofts it over the bowler's head for one.
FOUR! Gaby Lewis playing with the field here. It is full, on leg. Lewis clears her front leg and helps it over mid on. It races away. This is really smart batting.
A single now as this is worked to the off side.
LEG BYE! This is much fuller, outside off. Lewis shuffles again but gets lucky this time, as she misses her sweep but it goes past the stumps off the pads. They cross for a leg bye.
FOUR! Good use of the crease. Gaby Lewis walks way outside off. Afy Fletcher follows her with a short one. Lewis swivels and heaves it to deep square leg for four runs.
Eimear Richardson pushes this full ball from outside off to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Eimear Richardson tries to punch it through the line but misses.
Goes full and on off. Gaby Lewis gets a thick outside edge on it. The ball lobs towards third man. The batters take two quite comfortably.
Shorter, outside off. It comes it sharply off the deck. Gaby Lewis looks to cut it away but gets beaten on this occasion.
This is full, turning down leg. Eimear Richardson sweeps it to the right of short fine and crosses.
Karishma Ramharack now fires it quick and full, in-line with the stumps. Eimear Richardson gets an inside edge on her pads.

TWO LEG BYES! It is flatter and on off. Eimear Richardson goes for the reverse-sweep but misses. It hits her pads and goes down to third man. The batters collect two leg byes. Hayley Matthews though takes a review for lbw. The Ball Tracking confrims that the impact is outside the line and the on-field decision stands. So, 100 is up for Ireland Women.
Gaby Lewis drives this full one past mid off for a single.
Connell fires in a yorker, in the blockhole. Eimear Richardson jams it out back to the bowler.
Gaby Lewis slogs this full one to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Picturesque drive! It is full and on off. Gaby Lewis prods and creams it down the ground for an exquisite boundary.
LEG BYE! Fuller, angled into the pads. Eimear Richardson fails to flick it away. They cross for a leg bye.
NO BALL! A short ball, on middle. Eimear Richardson goes for the hook shot but misses. The umpire calls it as a wide as this is the second short ball.

OUT! CAUGHT! A soft dismissal. Orla Prendergast's valiant knock comes to an end. It is a low full toss, on off. Orla Prendergast tries to flick it away but is a bit early into her shot. The ball takes the leading edge and lobs towards covers. Zaida James stationed there takes a dolly. Can West Indies Women make the most of this opening?
Commentary.Howout: c Zaida James b Shamilia Connell

Commentary.Commentary: Who walks out now?
A sharp bumper, going down leg. Orla Prendergast tries to pull it away but misses.

FOUR! It is full, angled in on middle. Orla Prendergast comes down the wicket and whips it towards wide long on. The fielder from long on runs a long way to her right but touches the rope when she comes in contact with the ball.
Change. Shamilia Connell is back into the attack.
A short one, on leg stump. Orla Prendergast clears her front leg and tonks it to deep square leg. It meets the fielder on a bounce. They take a single.
On the pads, tucked to the leg side.
Orla Prendergast lofts this full ball over extra covers. Two more runs taken.
Loops it up, on off. Orla Prendergast lofts it over the bowler's head. The long off fielder comes across and keeps it down to two.
BYE! Quicker and full, wide of off. Gaby Lewis goes for the reverse-hit but misses. They collect a bye.

Short one, in the channel. Orla Prendergast swivels and pulls it high towards deep mid-wicket. The ball lands safely. Although, there is a bit of a mix-up between the batters but no damage done. A single is all they get.

NO BALL AND A SIX! There is one extra fielder outside the circle. It is a floated and full, on middle. Orla Prendergast gets low and slogs it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Free-Hit to follow.
A bit short, outside off. Orla Prendergast hangs back to cut it past cover. One taken.
Fuller, attacking the stumps. Orla Prendergast is solid in his defense.
On off, defended out.
Flat and straight, on middle. Orla Prendergast defends it to the right of the bowler.
It is short, outside off. Orla Prendergast dabs it down to third man and takes two runs.
FOUR! What a hit! It is full and on off. Orla Prendergast comes down the track and carves it past mid off for a cracking boundary.
Floated and full, on off. Orla Prendergast plays it gently to covers and crosses.
On the pads, tucked to the leg side for another single.
Orla Prendergast now rotates the strike as she knocks this full ball to the off side.
A single now as this is tapped to covers.
On off, driven to covers.
Floated and full, outside off. Lewis shuffles and tries to sweep it away but misses.
Two more runs this time as this is punched past point.
Orla Prendergast pulls this short one to wide of long on for a brace.
On off, defended out.
FOUR! Very full and outside off. Orla Prendergast steers it past backward point for four runs.
Short again, on off. Lewis pulls it away but it comes off the toe-end. It lands short of the long off fielder. One taken.
Shorter and on off, punched to cover for a single.
Full and on off. Orla Prendergast comes down the track and works it to sweeper cover for a single.
On middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
A single now as this is swept to deep mid-wicket.
Full, wide of off, over the tramline. Lewis does not reach out.
Floated and full, outside off. Orla Prendergast drives it to cover.
FOUR! Nicely played. It is full and on off. Orla Prendergast gets low and sweeps it along the ground through square leg for four runs.

FOUR! Up and over! Gaby Lewis gets her second boundary of the over. It is tossed up, full and on off. Lewis gets under and it plays a lofted drive to find another boundary. This will boost her confidence for sure.
It is fuller, drifting down leg. Orla Prendergast flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Orla Prendergast presses forward and blocks this full one back to the bowler.
A single now as this is tucked to mid on.
FOUR! Beats the fielder. It is slower through the air, on off. Lewis lunges and lofts it over mid off and evades the effort of the fielder there. It races away.
It is fuller, on middle. Gaby Lewis slogs it towards the cow corner. They take two before the fielder cuts it out.
Around off, defended out solidly.

FOUR! Forutune favours the brave they say and Orla Prendergast is certainly playing brave strokes here. It is flatter and on off. Orla Prendergast plays it very late. Luckily she sees it come off the cue-end and beat the slip fielder. The ball has enough legs to reach the third man fence.
A bit short, outside off. Orla Prendergast uses her feet once again but this time finds the fielder at cover.
Outside off. Lewis guides it to the left of backward point and gets to the other end.
Orla Prendergast charges down the wicket to this full delivery and helps it over the bowler's head for a single.
Shorter, outside off, turning in. Orla Prendergast tries to punch it off her back foot but misses it completely.
On the pads, Orla Prendergast tucks it to the leg side and retains the strike. She has been looking great ever since coming on. Gaby Lewis though need to keep herself calm.
Floated and full, on off, turning into the pads. Lewis hangs back and clips it through square leg. One taken.
Goes full and on off. Lewis goes for the sweep but gets it to square leg off the inside edge.
Fuller, on leg. Orla Prendergast lofts it over mid on for a single.
Loops it up, full and on off. Orla Prendergast comes down the track and goes through with her shot. It takes the under-edge and rolls to the fielder at first-slip.
Slower through the air, on leg. Orla Prendergast uses her feet and tucks it to the leg side.
Change. Hayley Matthews comes into the attack now.
LEG BYE! A length ball, drifting down leg. Orla Prendergast fails to flick it away. The ball brushes the pads and rolls out. They cross for a leg bye.
Tough chance! It is a short ball, on off. Orla Prendergast comes down the track and slaps it over point. The fielder is charging in from the deep but it just dies in front of her. Two runs taken.
Much fuller, outside off. Lewis leans in and drives it to backward point. There is a misfield and Gaby Lewis finally gets off the mark here.
Orla Prendergast comes down the track and smacks it to extra cover. They take one.
A length ball, on off. Orla Prendergast gently pushes it to the off side.

FOUR! EDGY! Does not matter how the runs come here. It is full, on fifth stump. Orla Prendergast slashes hard at it and gets a thick outside edge. Fortunately it flies over the slip fielder and runs down to the third man fence.
Orla Prendergast rocks back to this short ball and cuts it hard to point. They only get a single. A good over for Ireland Women.
FOUR! Solid shot. It is full, outside off. Orla Prendergast dances down the track, lofts it over covers and gets a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Orla Prendergast tries to heave it away but is no where near the ball.
Orla Prendergast drives this full ball through the line to sweeper cover for two more.
It is a length ball, around off. Orla Prendergast slaps it over covers. They take a couple off the Free-Hit.
TWO WIDES! It is sprayed full, wide outside off, swinging further away. It is out of Lewis' reach and also the keeper's. They sneak a single.
NO BALL! It is fuller, tailing into the pads. Lewis clears her front leg and makes the block. Guess what, Henry oversteps and a Free Hit to follow.
Back of a length, outside off. Orla Prendergast cuts it past point and calls for a single straightaway.
An inswinger now, full and on off. Lewis defends it out watchfully.
Orla Prendergast hangs back to this length ball. She taps it to the off side and rotates the strike.
Swing and a miss! A short ball, outside off. Orla Prendergast rocks back and tries to cut it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shamilia Connell draws first blood here. Amy Hunter perishes on just a single. She tries to break the shackles but holes out instead. It is a length ball, on middle and leg. Amy Hunter makes a wild heave across the line. The ball catches the outside edge and goes high up in the air towards mid-wicket. Trishan Holder takes a sharp catch running backwards. Orla Prendergast is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Trishan Holder b Shamilia Connell

Commentary.Commentary: Connell steams in and angles in a full-length ball. Amy Hunter charges down the wicket and looks to go downtown but misses.
It is full and straight, on off. Hunter pushes it towards point.
Shamilia Connell to share the new ball.
A low full toss, on off. Lewis jams it into the deck. A great start by Henry with the ball.
Three dots in a row now. Length and on off. Lewis dabs it out to point.
Once again Gaby Lewis goes hunting after a wide delivery but gets beaten.
Swing and a miss! Good length, outside off, moving away. Gaby Lewis tries to go after it but connects with clean air.
It is a length ball, around off. It nips away off the deck. Hunter opens the face late. It goes past the slip fielder off the outer half. One taken.
Some movement straightaway! Henry starts with a full one, outside off, shaping away further. Hunter tries to chase it but misses.

Done with all the pre-match proceedings! West Indies Women players are seen to be in a huddle before they take the field. Also, Gaby Lewis and Amy Hunter - the opening pair of Ireland Women make their way out on the crease on this cool evening in Cape Town. First all the players take the knee to support the BLM movement. It will be Chinelle Henry to start with the new ball. Let's play says the umpire and here we go...

Right then, the wait is over. Both the teams are seen walking out on the field. They will line-up in the middle of the park for their respective national anthems. It will be Ireland's first followed by West Indies' anthem. These two sides are meeting for the first time in the Women's T20 World Cup.

West Indies Women (Playing XI) - Hayley Matthews (C), Rashada Williams (WK), Shemaine Campbelle, Zaida James, Shabika Gajnabi, Chinelle Henry, Aaliyah Alleyne (In for Stafanie Taylor), Trishan Holder (In for Chedean Nation), Afy Fletcher, Karishma Ramharack, Shamilia Connell.

Ireland Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Amy Hunter, Gaby Lewis, Orla Prendergast, Laura Delany (C), Eimear Richardson, Louise Little, Mary Waldron (WK), Leah Paul, Arlene Kelly, Cara Murray, Jane Maguire.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Ireland Women. They will BAT first.
So then it is official that Britney Cooper has been given the thumbs-up to replace the injured player Chedean Nation. Toss a few minutes away...

West Indies Women haven't been able to perform well with the bat in this campaign. Also, they need to bring their A-game with the ball as they have hardly managed to put the batter under any serious pressure. However, Ireland Women have followed a similar pattern in this tournament. They need their batters to make it count this time around as they would facny themselves against a side with similar problems. A fiesty battle coming up. Toss and other updates coming up shortly.

Hello and a warm welcome to all! It is now time for match 13 in the Women's T20 World Cup 2023 where West Indies Women will be locking horns against Ireland Women. Both the teams are struggling to find their feet in this campaign. A win in this match is crucial for both of them, if they wish to have outside chance to make it to the semi-finals.
... MATCH DAY ...
